description: Apply seeded shared-channel brightness addition or alpha multiplication to a straight ARGB8 raster, returning detached pixels and the next random state.

provenance.relationship: Motivates the independently specified raster perturbation dependency; source RNG/hash, geometry and fragment scheduling excluded.
Motivates the independently specified raster perturbation dependency; source RNG/hash, geometry and fragment scheduling excluded.
Alpha-distribution observation only: coordinate hash and per-fragment overlap scheduling are excluded. Not a structural reproduction or whole-sketch coverage claim.

output_invariants: Same dimensions, detached unsigned32 packed pixels and exact next uint32 state. No input mutation or retained aliases.

behavior.validation: Exactly source,mode,range,exponent,rngState,maxWork in a passive Object/null-prototype record. Reject accessors, class instances, symbols, extra keys, coercion and booleans as numbers; proxies are outside passive interchange. Dense ordinary arrays with own data slots and no extra properties. Static validation order: outer record/keys; source record/keys; width; height; exact product <=2147483647; pixels shape then all pixel values in row-major order; mode; range shape then low then high then low<=high and for ALPHA_MULTIPLY low>=0; exponent finite>0; rngState; maxWork. Dimensions1..2147483647 and uint32/safe integer domains as schema. Canonicalize accepted zeros. Validate every pixel even for identity effect and insufficient budget. INVALID_INPUT is raised before work/algorithm arithmetic. No defaults.
behavior.work: After complete static validation require N=width*height<=maxWork or WORK_LIMIT, before range subtraction, random draws or output allocation. One abstract event per pixel includes one draw, one power and channel arithmetic; no skips for transparent pixels or identity intervals. Validation itself is O(N). Output storage O(N), auxiliary effect state O(1). Host resource exhaustion is a host error; no partial result escapes.
behavior.rng: LCG32 own state: state=(1664525*state+1013904223) modulo4294967296. A draw advances first, then u=state/4294967296. Zero is valid. Traverse y ascending then x ascending; exactly one draw per pixel even when source alpha0, low==high, source black, output clips, or effect is identity. Return final state. Calls can thread that state; seed replay is external state restoration. No ambient RNG, hash, time or renderer.
behavior.algorithm: Compute span=high-low after work preflight; nonfinite span is NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. For each pixel draw u, set q=fdlibm5.3Pow(u,exponent) (exponent1 may use exact u). Compute scaled=span*q then sample=low+scaled, checking each primitive for finiteness. RGB_ADD unpacks straight R,G,B and computes R+sample then G+sample then B+sample; preserve source alpha byte. ALPHA_MULTIPLY computes sourceAlpha*sample and preserves original straight RGB bytes. Quantize each changed channel by floor(min(255,max(0,value))+.5); nonfinite arithmetic fails before clamp. Repack unsigned32 ARGB. Preserve hidden RGB even when alpha quantizes to0; no premultiplication/unpremultiplication, color-space conversion, spatial interpolation or automatic compositing. A point sample at the high endpoint can occur from binary64 rounding even though uniform u<1. Source output arrays are separate and mutable value carriers; modifying returned pixels never changes input or later calls.
behavior.numerics: IEEE754 binary64 separately rounded primitive operations, no FMA/reassociation or binary32 narrowing. Power is the existing independently audited fdlibm5.3 e_pow numerical profile, including its positive-base/positive-exponent zero and underflow behavior; p5 implementation reuses packages/javascript/src/internal/fdlibm-pow.js with its Sun Microsystems notice. Do not substitute host Math.pow. Inputs u in[0,1) and exponent>0 imply q finite in[0,1]; underflow to0 is valid. Every primitive specified above must be finite or NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. No global epsilon; packed pixels, dimensions and RNG state compare exactly. uint32 transition may use unsigned Math.imul arithmetic. Preserve zero byte values.
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export seededPixelGrain(input) and SeededPixelGrainError from packages/javascript/src/seeded-pixel-grain.js and the public package index. Returns {raster:{width,height,pixels},rngState}; no native host objects. Other targets deferred.
behavior.adapter: Core requires no renderer. Editable native example requires p5 Canvas2D RGBA8 pixel read/write with pixelDensity(1), upper-left row-major order and explicit byte packing/unpacking. Call loadPixels after drawing and updatePixels after copying output. Process isolated transparent layers before compositing for alpha grain; never substitute flattened scene grain for per-fragment shader scheduling. Browser premultiplication may discard hidden transparent RGB on upload/readback; exact core hidden-RGB tests remain core evidence, while visible native output is checked separately. Save exports the already rendered canvas without reseeding or redraw. Pack straight p5 RGBA bytes as unsigned (A<<24)|(R<<16)|(G<<8)|B and unpack back without premultiplication. Native visual validation cannot attest hidden transparent RGB. The editable adapter rejects density other than1 or mismatched byte length before invoking core; unreadable/tainted canvas errors propagate visibly as host errors. These example checks are not another public core API.
behavior.environment: Only explicit input and the named deterministic power profile. No global RNG/noise/time, callbacks, image assets, shaders, fonts or persistent mutation.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Static schema/carrier/domain failure, before work and arithmetic.
errors.WORK_LIMIT: N exceeds maxWork after static validation; no draws or output.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: Nonfinite span or effect primitive; no partial raster or returned state.

source.unit: Straight encoded-sRGB ARGB8 pixels, upper-left row-major order.
source.evidence: Existing raster boundary; source cuadro grid600x800 and alpha-layer inputs. No image/default supplied.

mode.evidence: Source brightness addition in cuadraditos/minimalCirculines; source alpha multiplier in quadShadow. Separate semantics, no automatic selection.

range.unit: Two ordered additive byte offsets or nonnegative alpha factors.
range.evidence: Source brightness [0,10),[-5,5); alpha .001+u^.4. MinimalCirculines5->20 scored none after blur. No recommended interval; clipping allowed.

exponent.unit: Positive dimensionless power of uniform sample.
exponent.evidence: Source brightness is uniform (1); quadShadow uses .4. Explicit design control, no recommended range. Strictly positive excludes singular0^0 and negative powers.

rngState.evidence: Explicit state is a design divergence from Processing random and coordinate-hashed GLSL; no ambient source.

maxWork.evidence: Required allowance at least width*height before effect arithmetic/output allocation. Abstract work, not a memory or speed guarantee.

p5js.delivery_scope: p5 first; acceptance requires fixtures, native workflow and scoped reproduction evidence.

reproduction.acceptance: Selected cuadraditos static frame1 at600x800, raw benchmark gates and root image review; alpha-layer study and withheld pelotitas transfer recorded separately. No full-corpus claim.

review.status: Root contract accepted before implementation; independent challenge resolved in design_review. Target acceptance pending.

exclusions: HSB/saturation/hue grain, independent color-channel noise and random-grey crossfade
coordinate-hash/source-RNG or shader replay, per-fragment multisample grain and automatic layer capture
spatially correlated noise, varying masks, raster warps and temporal feedback
recommended parameter ranges, default source, hidden seeds and in-place writes
